bloques.titulo: Construction and use of Vorgangspassiv in present
texto: The passive process voice (**Vorgangspassiv**) is formed with the auxiliary verb **werden** conjugated in present and the **Partizip II** of the lexic verb in last position:
1. Main prayer: **Die Pakete werden heute gepackt** (packages are packed today / are being packed today).
2. **werden**: ich werde, du wirst, er / sie / es wird, wir werden, ihr werdet, sie / Sie werden.
3. In subordinate sentences (with **weil, dass, wenn**), the conjugated verb «werden» moves at the absolute end, behind the participle: **...weil die Ware sofort verschickt wird**.

frases.de: Werden die Pakete heute noch verschickt?
frases.en: Will the packages still be sent today?

frases.de: Ja, die Bestellungen werden gerade im Lager gepackt und danach abgeholt.
frases.es: Sí, los pedidos se están empaquetando ahora en el almacén y se recogerán después.
frases.en: Yes, the orders are being packed now in the warehouse and will be picked up later.

frases.de: Sehr gut. Und wie werden die Kunden informiert?
frases.es: Muy bien. ¿Y cómo se informa a los clientes?
frases.en: All right. And how are customers informed?

frases.de: Eine Benachrichtigung wird automatisch per E-Mail gesendet.
frases.es: Se envía una notificación automáticamente por correo electrónico.
frases.en: A notification is sent automatically by e-mail.

bloques.pregunta: What is the main function of the passive process (Vorgangspassiv)?

opciones.texto: Highlight the action or process in development no matter who runs it
opciones.explicacion: The passive places the communicative focus on the event that the object receives, not on the active agent.

opciones.texto: Indicate only the final state resulting from an object
opciones.explicacion: The resulting final state is expressed by the passive state with «sein» (Zustandspassiv).

opciones.texto: To force the subject to take action in the immediate future
opciones.explicacion: It expresses passive voice, not an order in an imperative way or a modal obligation.

bloques.pregunta: What position does the «wird/werden» auxiliary occupy in a causal subordinate with «weil»?

opciones.texto: At the absolute end of the sentence, immediately after the participle
opciones.explicacion: In the German subordinate structure, the conjugated verb («wird») closes the clause.

opciones.texto: In the second position, right after the subordinate connector
opciones.explicacion: The subordinate connector moves the conjugated verb to the end.

opciones.texto: In front of the subject of the subordinate prayer
opciones.explicacion: The investment only takes place in main sentences initiated by adverbe or complement.

bloques.frase: Die Bestellungen ___ heute im Lager gepackt.

opciones.explicacion: With the plural subject «die Bestellungen» the passive auxiliary present is «werden».
«wird» is 3rd person of singular; incompatible with «die Bestellungen» plural.
«worden» is the participle of «werden», not a conjugated verb of the present.
The passive requires the Partizip II («abgeholt») of the separable verb «abholen».
It's the form of infinitive without matching.
This is an active form of an indication.

bloques.pregunta: What does this system notice describe?
bloques.frase: Die Benachrichtigung wird automatisch per E-Mail gesendet.

opciones.texto: The notification is automatically sent by e-mail.
opciones.explicacion: «wird gesendet» describes an automated process in passive present.

opciones.texto: The customer must write a notification by hand and send it by post.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase points to a passive telematic automatic shipment.

opciones.texto: The company cancelled all notifications for lack of technical connection.
opciones.explicacion: It does not speak of any cancellation, but of a regular shipment in progress.

bloques.frase: Im Lager ___ jeden Tag viele Pakete verschickt.

opciones.explicacion: The «viele Pakete» subject is plural, so requires the «werden» auxiliary.
He is 3rd person of the singular; he would cause a numerical match error.
It is a form of time past Präteritum, not present usual.

bloques.explicacion: Wergen in second position and participle in the end.

intro: The passive process in present describes an action or transformation that is happening now, focusing on the fact and not on who runs it.
